summary: Review B on Phase 3 tasks 3.5 and 3.6 (the draft week review switch) at audited head 3a080e490: pass. Part 1, the value parse: showDraftWeeks() (apps/storytime/lib/content.ts:45-47) is true only for the exact value 1, reads the server-side process.env name STORYTIME_REVIEW_DRAFT_WEEKS (content.ts:39), never a NEXT_PUBLIC_ name, and no request input can set it. Every app importer of lib/content.ts is a server component (the four app/ page files hold no 'use client'; no components/ file imports it; look-not-found.test.tsx:424 pins this). Part 2, the fall-through: with the switch on, a draft week is judged by the published-week rules in loadVisibleWeek (content.ts:130-157): a missing picture still blocks, and media that is not approved still needs showDraftMedia(); highestOpenWeeks (content.ts:179-186) applies the identical rule with no log; no other gate changed (the phase diff touches only lib/content.ts in lib/; readiness.ts and lib/media/sign.ts are untouched). With the switch off, review is false and judged equals the loaded week, so the path is the old one (diff-verified). Part 3, the deploy-config test: case (f) scans every tracked deploy file that can set an env value for storytime (apps/storytime/cloudbuild.yaml, the Dockerfile via **/Dockerfile*, tracked .env* via **/.env*, .github/workflows/*.yml, the scripts/ci/apps.json storytime row); no Cloud Run service YAML or traffic file exists under apps/storytime; files_checked is asserted above 0 first, and my run records files_checked=25; case (g) is a real positive control (a scratch copy of the real cloudbuild.yaml with the name appended is caught). The adversarial test passes 13/13 through heavy-run. One nonblocking note: the scan misses docs/runbooks/storytime-deploy.md, the manual deploy runbook, which today sets no review name. A2 not triggered: no test flips a draft to published; the switch judges in memory and writes no file. A6: the registry claim matches the green test. Default on the runtime guard: not needed; the pipeline has no --set-env-vars path for the name; the accepted hand-set path is covered by the deploy-time service-environment check.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nonblocking] apps/storytime/__tests__/look-draft-week-switch.test.ts:204-218: the deploy scan of case (f) does not read docs/runbooks/storytime-deploy.md, the manual deploy runbook. Today the runbook sets no review name: its commands carry no --set-env-vars (docs/runbooks/storytime-deploy.md:24-26, 51-52). A future edit could add one there without a case (f) failure. Rationale: the scan covers every tracked pipeline file that can set an env value; the runbook is a human path outside the pipeline, and the PM accepted a test-only guard. Default: extend the scan to the runbook in a later cleanup, or add STORYTIME_REVIEW_DRAFT_WEEKS to the deploy-time service-environment check of the release track (storytime_at_home_release_20261106 plan task [b] 3.1 already reads the deployed revision environment for STORYTIME_SHOW_DRAFT_MEDIA). Note: gcloud run deploy with no --set-env-vars preserves a hand-set service env value across revisions, so a hand-set value would persist silently; the deploy-time environment read is the right control, not an app runtime guard.
